A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GSBAK paper, with all 32 pages and Appendices A–H available. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical scientific content; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v1 reports original attack experiments on ImageNet and PASCAL VOC 2012, including attack success rates, perturbation measurements, ablations and adversarial examples in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons, appendix ablations and crafted adversarial examples.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain identical gradient-based initialization, targeted and untargeted gradient estimators, and semicircular boundary search. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet and PASCAL VOC 2012 for the same single-label and multi-label top-K attack scenarios, including best, random and worst target-label sets. Appendix coverage is also identical.

E2.justification: SimBA-DCT, PPBA for untargeted attacks, Square Attack and its top-K adaptation retain their membership in the corresponding comparisons. The alternative gradient estimators and initialization comparators in Appendix A are unchanged.

E3.justification: Sample sizes, image resizing, target-label selection, evaluated classifiers, query budgets, perturbation thresholds and evaluation metrics are identical in Section 5 and the appendices.

E4.justification: The gradient-estimator, non-adversarial-query and initialization ablations in Appendix A are identical. Robust-classifier tests, sensitivity to K and frequency-subspace size, and adversarial-example studies in Appendices D–F and H are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions use identical point estimates, means, medians and curves. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical tables, result curves and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 1 retains top-1 untargeted ASR of 98.7% for GSBA1 and 93.6% for SA1 at Q=20000 and rth=2 in both versions.

T1.justification: The threat-model definitions, optimization formulation and gradient-estimator equations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements and conclusion are identical. Claims concerning geometric top-K attacks, adaptive gradient estimation, the Square Attack adaptation and effectiveness across classification settings retain the same scope.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix G retains the same limitations concerning query demands, decision-boundary curvature and poor transferability, together with the same discussion of potential negative impacts.

D1.justification: Sections 4–5 and Appendix F provide identical hyperparameters, model sources, preprocessing instructions, DCT noise-sampling details and code-access information. No reproducibility details are added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper and the bibliography are identical. Positioning relative to CGBA, Square Attack and existing top-K white-box attacks is unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 17 Mar 2025 to v3 dated 30 May 2025. The title, authors, prose, section structure and appendices are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–19, Tables 1–11 and Algorithm 1 retain identical formatting, captions and placement. Page layouts are unchanged; the updated margin-stamp text introduces no layout revision.

improvement.justification: The complete main text and appendices retain identical methods, evidence, explanations and presentation. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp has no meaningful effect on scientific quality, clarity or reproducibility.
